package_manifest_parity: build_manifest, validator, and packager apply the same root/nested __pycache__ exclusions.

wal_poem: discovers v1/v2/v3 draft specs, verifies historical/current database-WAL pairs on read-only disposable copies, checks semantic assertions and safe build profiles, and for v3 requires tool-generated full-row primary-key-ordered snapshots covering every user table; rejects packaged -shm files.

current_surface_canonicality: current navigation agrees with STATE; every poem-index row’s current aliases agree with its own head; anthology rankings contain only real candidate records with existing candidate packets.
oci_whiteout_artifact: descriptor digests/sizes, safe unique tar paths, exact lower objection, zero-byte upper whiteout, merged absence, and both manifest layers must verify.
release_path_safety: manifest and package collection reject symlinks, unsafe paths, and case-fold collisions; completed zip is reopened and hash-verified before sidecar emission.
oci_whiteout_phase_order: apply all whiteouts to pre-layer state before ordinary same-layer entries, regardless of tar order; verify D001 explicit and D002 opaque contracts independently.
oci_poem_blob_closure: for D002, reject any blob not reachable through index, manifest, config, and declared layer descriptors; this is a project-local closed-world rule.
oci_declared_path_containment: canonicalize and prove spec, artifact, layout, descriptor, and tar paths remain beneath declared roots with no symlink components before blob I/O or artifact writes.
oci_descriptor_preflight: require exact sha256:<64 lowercase hex>, declared size, and project-local size bound before constructing or reading a blob path.
candidate_freeze: preserve exact creation-time P0004-D002 draft and OCI artifact hashes after later-turn internal promotion; no D003 by inertia.
proof_status_family_truth: current proof aliases and structured P0002/P0003/P0004 family entries must agree with poem_index, existing paths, candidate/freeze state, and zero-response reader routing.
frozen_surface_wrapper_binding: immutable creation-time artifact files are validated by hashes in the current candidate wrapper rather than forced to repeat a later revision or head.
